S01.title: ROMEO & JULIET
S01.tagline: She has already died once. This time she has a deadline.
S02.vo: The vault at night. He believes you dead.|"Here's to my love."|He drinks, and the cup falls from his open hand.
S02.caption: Here's to my love.
S02a.vo: Cold stone. You wake to an empty cup beside him.|"If I had one more chance — I would never let you die."|Then white light takes the tomb, and the night begins again.
S02a.spoiler: 🔮 YOU ALREADY READ THIS ENDING: the letter never reaches Mantua. Change that, change everything.
S02a.caption: If I had one more chance... I would never let you die.
S02b.vo: Her own heartbeat, loud as a drum.|The mirror shows a girl who has not yet been to a funeral.|Downstairs the musicians are tuning. The masque is about to begin.
S02b.caption: I'm... alive again? This time, I will not let you die, Romeo.
S03.objective: Walk in like it is the first time
S03.vo: Torches. Masks. The same song, played at the same hour.|You are breathing. Nothing has happened yet.|You know every page of this. Tonight you burn one.
S04.vo: Across the hall: Romeo. Whole. Laughing at something small.|You buried this boy. He has not even met you.|Smile. Let nothing on your face give the ending away.
S04.caption: I don’t know your name. I already know I’m in trouble.
S04b.vo: He crosses the hall like it is the easiest thing in the world.|"My hand is a poor pilgrim," he says, raising his palm to yours. "It has walked all night for one blessing."|"Then pray properly, pilgrim. Palms touching — that is how saints kiss."
S04b.caption: My hand is a poor pilgrim. It has walked all night for one blessing.
S04c.vo: "Then pray properly, pilgrim. Palms touching — that is how saints kiss."|The music slows. He is close enough now that the candle heat on your face is his.
S04c.ask: You know this kiss. It is the first page of everything. How does it happen this time?
S04c.intel: 👁 The kiss is not a choice. The script only argues about how.
S04c.opt.0.label: Let it land exactly as it did the first time.
S04c.opt.1.label: Kiss him first. Rewrite the opening line.
S04c.opt.2.label: Hold the palm one beat longer. Make him wonder.
S04d.vo: The kiss lands — brief, soft, and it still ends the world.|"You kiss by the book."|Then the Nurse is at your elbow, and the night moves on.
S04d.caption: You kiss by the book.
S04e.objective: Act like you did not know
S04e.vo: Then the Nurse leans in with the name you have known for a lifetime: Montague.|Last time, that word split the night open. Tonight you must act as if it still can.|"My only love sprung from my only hate." You even remember your own line.
S04e.caption: His name is Romeo, and a Montague.|My only love sprung from my only hate.
S05.objective: Choose how to spend the night
S05.vo: He is gone into the crowd, and the name Montague hangs in the air.|You know how tonight ends. You know how everything ends.
S05.ask: The script says: balcony, vows, a secret wedding at dawn. What do you do with what you know?
S05.intel: 👁 Every hour you spend watching is an hour the story keeps.
S05.opt.0.label: Follow the script. Be on the balcony when he comes.
S05.opt.1.label: Meet him in the garden first. Skip the script three pages.
S05.opt.2.label: Before he leaves, warn him: stay away from Tybalt tomorrow.
S06b.vo: He finds the wall under your window somehow — climbs it like a man who has never once considered falling.|"But soft, what light through yonder window breaks? It is the east, and Juliet is the sun."|You have read this line a hundred times. It has never once sounded like this.
S06b.caption: But soft, what light through yonder window breaks? It is the east, and Juliet is the sun.
S06d.vo: You lean further over the rail than caution allows — love, if it is real, does not need a whole night of games.|"If your intentions are honourable, and your purpose marriage, send me word tomorrow, and I will follow you the whole world over."|He swears it without a heartbeat of hesitation. Tomorrow. A priest. A ring neither family has blessed. By the time the candle gutters, you have already promised yourselves to each other.
S06d.caption: If your intentions are honourable, and your purpose marriage — send me word tomorrow.
S06.vo: Friar Laurence marries you at dawn, then explains the sleeping draught.|You stop him. The draught is clever. The letter is not.|This time the letter does not travel alone.
S06.caption: These violent delights have violent ends.
S07.vo: Tybalt kills Mercutio. Romeo kills Tybalt. The street stops arguing.|By sunset Romeo is banished to Mantua.|Forty-two hours until he buys the poison. Starting now.
S07.caption: A plague on both your houses!
S06c.vo: One night. The only page of the story where nobody is running.|Then the lark sings, and he swears it is the nightingale, and you both know better.|He goes down the ladder, and your hand is the last thing to let go.
S06c.caption: It was the nightingale, and not the lark.|It was the lark, the herald of the morn.
S07b.vo: Your father names the day. Thursday. Count Paris. No argument.|Your hand is money he has already spent.
S07b.ask: The draught needs time. How do you buy it?
S07b.intel: 👁 A daughter who agrees is a daughter nobody watches.
S07b.opt.0.label: Agree to Paris. Smile. Take the days you need.
S07b.opt.1.label: Bring the Nurse in. You need a second pair of hands.
S07b.opt.2.label: Refuse him now, loudly, in front of the whole house.
S08.vo: Plague has closed the roads. Every gate has a checkpoint now.|One letter has to reach Mantua before the rumour does.
S08.intel: 👁 Plague quarantine stops monks. Gold moves faster than faith.
S08.opt.0.label: The Friar’s own order. The proper road, the slow one.
S08.opt.1.label: Hire a rider. Fast, silent, paid not to ask.
S08.opt.2.label: Sell your jewellery. Ride for Mantua yourself, tonight.
S09.title: THE RACE
S09.goalText: Reach Mantua before the news of your death does. Then he never buys poison.
S09.round.0.ask: A quarantine line across the road. Fever tents. Guards turning everyone back.
S09.round.0.intel: 👁 Guards on plague duty are underpaid and a long way from home.
S09.round.0.opt.0.label: Give the captain your mother’s ring.
S09.round.0.opt.0.react: The ring vanishes into his glove. The barrier lifts.
S09.round.0.opt.1.label: Argue. Tell them exactly whose daughter you are.
S09.round.0.opt.1.react: A Capulet name buys nothing out here. They wave you off.
S09.round.0.opt.2.label: Wait for dark. Walk the ditch past the tents.
S09.round.0.opt.2.react: You get through. It costs four hours of the forty-two.
S09.round.1.ask: The horse is finished. One drover, one fresh bay, one bad price.
S09.round.1.intel: 👁 He knows exactly how badly you need it. So do you.
S09.round.1.opt.0.label: Pay whatever he asks. Do not haggle.
S09.round.1.opt.0.react: You leave broke and moving. Moving is the only currency left.
S09.round.1.opt.1.label: Take the bay while he sleeps.
S09.round.1.opt.1.react: He wakes. You run the next miles on your own feet.
S09.round.1.opt.2.label: Trade your wedding dress for his donkey.
S09.round.1.opt.2.react: A donkey is not fast. A donkey is not nothing.
S09.round.2.ask: The road forks. The short way is under brown water. The long way climbs.
S09.round.2.intel: 👁 Four hours saved is four hours he is still alive.
S09.round.2.opt.0.label: Swim the horse across. Now.
S09.round.2.opt.0.react: You come out the far bank soaked, shaking, and hours ahead.
S09.round.2.opt.1.label: Take the long climb. Late, but arriving.
S09.round.2.opt.1.react: The hills cost you four hours. The letter is still dry.
S09.round.2.opt.2.label: Turn back and look for a ferry.
S09.round.2.opt.2.react: There is no ferry. There is only the time you spent looking.
S09.round.3.ask: A rider comes the other way. Balthasar, carrying the news of your death.
S09.round.3.intel: 👁 Whatever he tells Romeo first is the version Romeo believes.
S09.round.3.opt.0.label: Stop him. Show him your face. Let him look.
S09.round.3.opt.0.react: He stares at a dead girl who is breathing, and turns around.
S09.round.3.opt.1.label: Ride past. Let him get there first.
S09.round.3.opt.1.react: He rides on with your funeral in his mouth.
S09.round.3.opt.2.label: Pull him down and take his packet.
S09.round.3.opt.2.react: You win the packet. He runs for Mantua anyway, on foot.
S10a.title: THE SECOND LETTER
S10a.body: The letter reached Mantua with six hours to spare. Romeo never found the apothecary.|He was sitting in the dark of the tomb when you opened your eyes.|Two families came expecting a funeral and got an argument instead.
S10a.epiGlory: Verona will tell this as the tale of the girl who tore up the script in the open — and dared the ending to stop her.
S10a.epiWisdom: No ballad will ever mention how quietly it was done. That was the plan, and the plan held.
S10a.epiHeart: You did not outrun fate alone. You were carried by everyone who loved you — and this time, you let them.
S10b.title: NO WHITE LIGHT
S10b.body: The rumour got to Mantua first. It always travelled lighter than paper.|You wake to the same cold hand and the same empty vial.|This time the light does not come. This time you stay.
S10b.nextNote: You knew every page. Knowing was not enough.
S10b.epiGlory: You were bold enough to break every rule but one: the clock was never impressed by courage.
S10b.epiWisdom: Every trick worked except the last. The rumour was the better schemer.
S10b.epiHeart: They all loved you. Love simply reached Mantua second.
D1.title: CAUSE OF DEATH: THURSDAY
D1.body: You refused Paris in front of the whole house. Your father moved the wedding up.|The door locked from the outside. The letter was never written.|Forty-two hours, and you spent none of them.
